meta.title: 'Turn on' after one denial re-asks; after a second denial it opens app settings; granting there switches to device origin
meta.requirement: AC6 — re-ask if the OS allows, else app settings; return with permission → device origin without restart
precondition: Explore opened once and denied (banner visible)
steps: Open Explore and deny once → check: banner shows
Tap 'Turn on' → check: the system dialog appears again
Deny again (now blocked); tap 'Turn on' → check: the app's settings screen opens
Grant location (`pm grant`, the settings toggle's effect) and return to the app with Back
expected: After the first denial 'Turn on' shows the OS dialog again — UI tree + screenshot
After the second denial 'Turn on' opens Android app settings for the Irbis package (not the dialog) — UI tree (settings screen text) + screenshot
Back in the app without a restart: banner gone, header '… places near you', event explore_loaded {origin: device} after the return — UI tree + QA event

caption.expected: After the first denial 'Turn on' shows the OS dialog again

done: Guest, location permission reset to 'ask' · Mock device position = Tashkent centre · Explore opened once and denied (banner visible)
